data.one_liner: Dart wrapper for the material-components-web javascript library
data.what_it_does: It provides Dart bindings and wrapper classes for the material-components-web JavaScript library, allowing web developers to use MDC components directly in Dart. It includes classes like MDC* corresponding to the Material Design Web component reference.
use_when: You are building a web application in Dart and want to use the official material-components-web components.
You need access to specific MDC JavaScript classes via Dart wrappers.
avoid_when: You are building standard Flutter mobile or desktop applications rather than targeting Dart web with JS libraries.
You require foundation and adapter classes for deep customization within other web frameworks.
strengths: Direct mapping of material-components-web classes to Dart.
Well-documented classes with links to design guidelines, component references, and demos.
weaknesses: Foundation and adapter classes are currently beyond the scope of this package.
Requires manual inclusion of the JavaScript library script in index.html.
data.setup_notes: Include the material-components-web script in your index.html just before the main.dart.js script.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:mdc_web/mdc_web.dart';

// Use MDC* classes as described by the Material Design Web component reference.
